title: Angry Birds Star Wars II
notes: Physical ARM64 smoke test on 2026-10-09. Exact IPA SHA-256 D1858BB439E992DE6950446C64DDFDB9DD04EB9DBC44BB4F4CB080B5720F9EDE. The supplied filename and display name say only Angry Birds, but the bundle identifier and executable identify Angry Birds Star Wars II. Splash, menu, episode/level selection and first level render. A touch drag fires a bird and the score reaches 360. Audio, saves, later levels and sustained performance were not tested; this is not a full-game approval.
